body:
Root cause confirmed: apps2/server-go's PacketChat handler only relayed ChatYell to IDUNA, so a player's default chat box (ChatSay) never reached Minecraft -- the founder-reported one-directional bug. Found apps2/mud already relays say+yell+guild (deliberately excluding tell -- 'a DM isn't meant for a wider audience'); brought server-go to parity with that already-correct, already-shipped precedent instead of guessing at a new policy. go build/vet/test all green. Commit 6cf2ad2.

⚓ ☃
title: S232-01 fix: server-go chat bridge now relays say+guild to EINHORN_SURVIVAL, not just yell
